experiments.name: datetime-baseline

Hot operations exclude startup. timeParse/timeAdd read nanosecond; timeRoundFormat includes formatting. Gzip level9, esbuild es2022 minification. Separately compressed module sums and consumer bundles are alternative delivery modes.
